art_note: The model image uses a composited look typical of mass-market suppliers, detracting from the luxury positioning.
desc_en: A refined silhouette defines this essential piece. The design features a flattering wide round neckline and long flared sleeves that introduce subtle movement. Crafted from a soft and supple stretch fabric, it follows the natural lines of the body with effortless ease. Each garment is made to order to ensure exceptional standards. Worldwide shipping is available for every order.
desc_es: Una silueta depurada define esta prenda esencial. El diseño presenta un favorecedor cuello redondo amplio y mangas largas acampanadas que aportan un movimiento sutil. Confeccionado con un tejido suave y elástico, acompaña las líneas naturales del cuerpo con absoluta ligereza. Cada pieza se confecciona bajo pedido en nuestras instalaciones. Ofrecemos envíos a todo el mundo para su comodidad.
details_en:
